```yaml
name: E2E Portal Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  e2e-portal:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Node & Playwright setup
      - name: Set up Node
        uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm
          force-install: false

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Run Playwright UI tests
        run: pnpm exec playwright test --reporter=junit --output=playwright-report/junit.xml
        env:
          BASE_URL: https://portal.example.com
          PLAYWRIGHT_JUNIT_OUTPUT: playwright-report/junit.xml

      - name: Upload Playwright test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-test-results
          path: playwright-report

      - name: Publish Playwright test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: Playwright Tests
          path: playwright-report/junit.xml
          reporter: junit
          fail-on-error: true
          fail-on-empty: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      # Rust setup and imix_connect
      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Build imix_connect binary
        run: cargo build --release --bin imix_connect

      - name: Run imix_connect with SOCKS5 UDP support
        run: ./target/release/imix_connect --config tests/imix_connect_config.toml
        env:
          SOCKS5_UDP_ENABLED: "true"

      # Traffic verification
      - name: Run traffic verification script
        run: cargo run --release --bin traffic_verifier
        env:
          VERIFICATION_MODE: "e2e"

      - name: Upload traffic verification logs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: traffic-verification-logs
          path: logs/traffic_verification.log
```
